risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-tier model (e.g., Xbox One S 500GB) or as not working, since storage and model are critical for pricing.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated/missing
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's home screen showing the game library or a video of the console launching a game.

risks.risk: Console may be damaged or non-functional
